title: Competition and Consumer Amendment (Exploitation of Indigenous Culture) Bill 2017
short_title: Competition and Consumer Amendment (Exploitation of Indigenous Culture) Bill 2017

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would change the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 to stop non-Indigenous Australians and foreigners from making money off Indigenous art, souvenirs, and other cultural expressions.
It would set up a new committee, funded from normal budget supply, to oversee these changes.
The bill would start the day after it receives Royal Assent.
changes: The bill would amend the Competition and Consumer Act 2010.
The bill would establish a new committee.
The bill would commence the day after Royal Assent.
summary.affected: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, Indigenous artists, and those who sell Indigenous-style art and souvenirs.
